briefHtml:
NAV and the tape

  • NAV S$10,216,741 · reported -0.38% · real day move ≈ -0.04% (S$-4,555 vs Thursday's restated 10,221,296). NAV level authoritative.
  • Biggest mover in the book's world: NVDA -4.34% to $166.19 after Jensen Huang RESIGNED as CEO, effective immediately — opened -14%, now ~-30% in a month, below a $4tn market cap. Earnings 17 Nov now land in a governance vacuum.
  • The one thing: the 10y jumped +12bp to 5.12% (Trump dismissed an immediate Iran deal → WTI ~$89; SF Fed's Daly biased to more tightening; FedWatch 89% 25bp / 11% 50bp). The 5.20% Defense gate is ~8bp away — one hot PPI (tonight 9:30pm SGT) could touch it.
  • Watcher fired 4 critical riskFlags (Tencent, CDL, silver x2) — directionally right but magnitudes overstated on stale baselines: Tencent real -2.64% (flag -7.3%), CDL real -6.74% (flag -9.4%, 52-week low 6.40 on 4x volume), silver real -3.47% (flag -5.0%).
  • Metals smashed on a 19-month-high dollar: gold $3,866.51 -3.05%, silver $49.88 -3.47%, back below $50, ratio 77.5. Silver line now ~1.97x.
  • SMIC Q3 beat after the HK close: revenue $3.190bn +33.9% y/y (~+3% beat), net income $428m (~+17% beat), Q4 guided +4–6% q/q (accelerating). Reaction day today; call 8:30am SGT. CSCO beat big after the US close (rev +24%, EPS +40%, FY guide raised); AMAT figures not yet retrieved.

Flag integrity

  • riskFlags: FOUR critical — first flags in a week. All four point at real large moves; treat printed magnitudes as upper bounds (stale ~5-session baselines on Tencent and CDL).
  • L46.SI (Lum Chang): Yahoo 404, 32nd consecutive session.
  • Nov 12 NAV restated DOWN to 10,221,296 (from 10,236,161) → reported -0.38% embeds offset; real ≈ -0.04%.
  • listedChgPct -2.19% — a genuine down-day read this time (Thu Asia and Thu US both fell).

Insider trades (last 7 days)

  • None found. SGX links API 404 for a third consecutive day — web sweep only.
  • Wing Tai: nothing newer than the 4 Nov Form 1 — pause now five trading sessions (5, 6, 10, 11, 12 Nov).
  • DBS, Fraser and Neave, VICOM, Straits Trading, City Developments, UOL, Ho Bee, Seatrium, YZJ, Singtel, Keppel REIT; HK names Tencent, SMIC, Xiaomi: none found. US sleeve is ETFs — no insider filings exist.

Congress trades (STOCK Act)

  • None new. Newest items remain the 9 Nov batch (NY-3 T-bills x2; TN-8 WBD sale; AK WDC sale). Nothing filed 10–12 Nov.

Trump and policy watch (24–48h)

  • Trump dismisses immediate Iran deal — WTI ~$89, 10y +12bp to 5.12%. Inflation-from-oil channel live; 5.20% gate ~8bp away. Yahoo
  • Jensen Huang resigned as NVDA CEO, effective immediately; Reuters reports a third alleged affair; US probe of Alice Huang over China chip links. NVDA -4.34% to $166.19 (opened -14%). Earnings 17 Nov; Anthropic IPO confirmed 19 Nov.
  • Daly hawkish: bias is further tightening; FedWatch 89% 25bp / 11% 50bp for December. PPI tonight 9:30pm SGT is the next input.
  • SMIC beat (+33.9% y/y revenue, Q4 guide accelerates to +4–6% q/q) — direct read-through to the China/HK tech sleeve. RTTNews
  • Metals smashed on 19-month-high dollar: gold -3.05% to $3,866.51; silver -3.47% to $49.88, below $50; ratio 77.5. USAGOLD
  • Week closes with PPI tonight; US-China truce renewal notices beyond the ships-301 extension still unsighted — snapback risk technically open. USTR

Risk

  • Silver line: 1,777 oz x $49.88 x 1.2868 ≈ S$114,058 collateral vs S$56,240 loan → equity ≈ S$57,818, ratio ≈ 1.97x — pressing the 2x zone; one more down-leg from forced-deleveraging territory.
  • Duration gate proximity: 10y 5.12% vs 5.20% gate = ~8bp, one hot PPI away; gate plan must be executable tonight.
  • NVDA governance vacuum 4 days before earnings; Anthropic IPO 19 Nov — two volatility nodes next week.
  • CDL 52-week low on 4x volume (UOL flat — name-specific); watch read-across to Wing Tai / Ho Bee if yields keep climbing.
  • Concentration and FX: ~35% of net worth non-SGD at USDSGD 1.2868; unlisted plus property still dominate.

Alpha — signals, not advice (~62% of the liquid book idle cash)

  • TLT / Defense sleeve: 10y 5.12%, gate 5.20% ~8bp away, PPI tonight. Signal: alert armed — deploy first tranche AT the gate; a hot PPI likely overshoots, and the overshoot is the better fill, so stage the order.
  • SMIC (0981.HK): beat plus accelerating Q4 guide. Signal: staged-entry trigger met IF price holds above ~HK$46–47 post-print today; the 8:30am SGT call's gross-margin detail (guide 26–28%) is the confirm/kill input.
  • Silver / real assets: spot below $50 — the flagged entry is here. Signal: line at ~1.97x is ABOVE the 1.7x health bar, so no adds; discipline flips from wait-to-add to watch-for-forced-deleveraging. Adds stay on hold until ratio below 1.7x AND spot reclaims $55.

trumpWatch.title: Trump dismisses immediate Iran deal — oil up, 10y +12bp to 5.12%
trumpWatch.detail: Trump said he has no plans to bring an immediate end to the war; WTI rallied to ~$89 and the 10y jumped +12bp to 5.12% on the post-Veterans-Day reopen (30y 5.44%). The 5.20% duration gate is now ~8bp away with PPI tonight 9:30pm SGT.

trumpWatch.title: Jensen Huang resigned as NVDA CEO, effective immediately
trumpWatch.detail: NVDA opened -14% and closed -4.34% at $166.19, ~-30% in a month and below a $4tn market cap. Reuters reports a third alleged affair; US investigators probing Alice Huang over China chip-smuggling links. Earnings 17 Nov now land in a governance vacuum; AVGO +5.5% and AMD +5.9% on the share-shift bid.

trumpWatch.title: Daly hawkish; December 50bp tail grows to 11%
trumpWatch.detail: SF Fed's Daly: 'my bias is that further tightening will be needed... consistent pressure on inflation that isn't simply in the sectors most directly affected by tariffs or oil'. FedWatch: 89% 25bp / 11% 50bp for December. PPI tonight (9:30pm SGT) is the next input. Jobless claims 200k, steady.

trumpWatch.title: SMIC Q3 beat with accelerating Q4 guide
trumpWatch.detail: Revenue $3.190bn +33.9% y/y (~+3% above consensus $3.094bn; +6.1% q/q); net income $428.4m vs ~$366m expected (+17%); Q4 guided +4% to +6% q/q vs Q3's +2–4% guide. Closed HK$48.74 -0.53% before the print; reaction day and 8:30am SGT call today.

trumpWatch.title: Metals smashed on a 19-month-high dollar
trumpWatch.detail: Gold $3,866.51 -3.05% (-$121.46; broke $3,900, third down session); silver $49.88 -3.47% (-$1.79), back below $50; gold/silver ratio 77.5. Hike repricing plus dollar strength squeezes the whole real-assets sleeve.

trumpWatch.title: PPI tonight; truce renewal notices still unsighted
trumpWatch.detail: PPI lands tonight 9:30pm SGT with the 10y 8bp under the 5.20% gate. Beyond USTR's 6 Nov two-month extension of the ships-301 suspension, no further US-China truce renewal notice has been sighted after the 10 Nov tariff-expiry date — snapback risk technically open. CSCO beat big after the close (rev +24% y/y, adj EPS +40%, FY guide raised); Anthropic confirmed IPO 19 Nov.

opportunities.thesis: Defense/long-duration sleeve (15% target): 10y jumped +12bp to 5.12% on the Iran-deal dismissal and Daly's hawkish bias — now ~8bp below the 5.20% deployment gate with PPI tonight 9:30pm SGT and an 11% 50bp December tail.
opportunities.signal: Alert armed: deploy the first tranche AT the gate (5.20%), not before. A hot PPI likely overshoots the gate — the overshoot is the better fill, so stage the order tonight rather than chase. ~62% of the liquid book still idle cash.

opportunities.thesis: Asia semis: SMIC Q3 beat — revenue $3.190bn +33.9% y/y (~+3% above consensus), net income +17% above expectations, Q4 guided to ACCELERATE at +4–6% q/q (vs +2–4% prior guide). Closed HK$48.74 before the print; reaction day today.
opportunities.signal: Staged-entry trigger from the zone-breakout thesis is met IF price holds above ~HK$46–47 post-print today; the 8:30am SGT call's gross-margin detail (guide 26–28%) is the confirm/kill input. A drop back into the HK$44–46 zone remains the cheaper entry.

opportunities.thesis: Real-assets sleeve (20% target): silver $49.88, -3.47% and back below $50 on a 19-month-high dollar — the sub-$50 entry the briefs have flagged is here. But the leveraged IBKR line is ~1.97x, above the 1.7x health bar.
opportunities.signal: No adds: the line being above 1.7x overrides the sub-$50 price signal. Discipline flips from wait-to-add to watch-for-forced-deleveraging (equity ~S$57.8k on ~S$114.1k collateral vs the fixed S$56.24k loan). Adds stay on hold until ratio below 1.7x AND spot reclaims $55.
